latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Subtitle Generator From Audio (v1.0.0).
- Instantly generate subtitles from uploaded audio (MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC, up to 500MB) and export as captioned videos.
- Simple cloud setup—no installation required; connect automatically and confirm when ready.
- Supports direct exports to MP4 (and other formats), timeline previews, and session-based project editing.
- Built-in error handling for expired tokens, large files, unsupported formats, and usage limits.
- Ideal for podcasters, creators, and educators needing fast, accurate captions without manual work.
